name: Red Velvet Flavoured Ice Cream
ingredients_raw: Ice Cream (67%): (Milk Solids, Sugar, Water, Cocoa Solids, Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471, 477), Stabilizers (412, 410), Nature-Identical Flavoring Substance & Color (129)). Spraying & Toppings (18%): Cocoa Flavored Confectionery (Edible Vegetable Oils (Coconut Oil & Palm Kernel Oil), Sugar, Maltodextrin, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier (322) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances) & Cookie Crumble (Humectant (422), Raising Agent (503(ii), 500(ii)), Acidity Regulator (450(i), 330), Emulsifier (322) & Nature-Identical Flavoring Substances). Wafer Cone (15%): (Water, Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Kernel Oil), Emulsifier (322), Nature-Identical Flavoring Substances & Colors (129, 162)). Allergen Information: Contains Milk & Wheat. Manufactured in the same facility which processes Nuts, Oats & Soy.
